fire: A brown leaf landed softly on the surface of the pond.
She slid a clean sheet of paper into the typewriter.
The wind tore a page from his notebook and carried it off.
A single oak leaf was pressed between the pages of the diary.
Fern fronds unrolled slowly in the damp shade.
He wrapped the cheese in a thin sheet of wax paper.
A maple leaf, bright red, clung to the windscreen.
Every sheet of the old map had yellowed at the edges.
quiet: A brown duck landed softly on the surface of the pond.
She slid a clean cup of coffee across the desk.
The wind tore the hat from his head and carried it off.
A single oak acorn was kept in the drawer of the desk.
Fern roots spread slowly in the damp shade.
He wrapped the cheese in a thick cloth bag.
A small stone, bright red, sat on the windowsill.
Every corner of the old house had cracked over time.
